get.description: Without any of these query parameters, returns the latest 100 traces as {data}. With at least one, returns a newest-first page as {data, nextCursor}; nextCursor is null on the last page. Invalid parameters return 400.

parameters.description: Only traces attributed to this agent ID (from the authenticating client key metadata)
parameters.name: actorId

parameters.description: Only traces authenticated by this client key ID
parameters.name: clientKeyId

parameters.description: Only traces created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page
parameters.name: cursor
